svg.title: SolveTide: local conductivity edit and global field response
svg.desc: Actual accepted heat fields for contrasts 2.00 and 2.10 on the same unit-square mesh, with a separately scaled signed difference; the dashed top-right quadrant is the edited region. All 441 values and 800 triangular cells are retained.
